Upon answer, they were met with a beautiful woman in a blue and white kimono dress, who flashed them a dazzling smile, matched with a coy wink.

Referring to the mountain of jewellery, rolled-up maps, barrels of tangerines, bundles of clothes and... Treasure chests, all stacked together right outside her door. Before you could consider declining, Nami would bat those open orange orbs, her expression enticing with a tilted her of mirth, "I would be *really* grateful for the help!"
